the identification of the molecular basis of wound healing and the development of novel strategies to accelerate the healing of chronic wounds.
the development of natural products and natural agents for wound care and wound healing.
the identification and development of new and innovative approaches for the prevention, treatment and cure of chronic wounds.

nature has already developed a wide range of tools to address wound repair and that we should look for the best of them to address our current needs.

the body has a natural capacity for wound healing, which is not fully understood.
the natural approach to wound healing is not only possible but also effective.
the body has the capacity to heal wounds, but the body is also capable of causing wounds.

platelets are not just a ‘blood clotting’ factor but a key component of innate immunity and a powerful source of tissue repair.
